section.41: The Book of al-Fara' and al-'Atirah

41.name_native: The Book of al-Fara' and al-'Atirah

hadiths.text: It was narrated from Ibn' Abbas, from Maimunah, that:the Prophet was asked about a mouse that had fallen into some solid cooking fat. He said. "Take it, and whatever is around it, and throw it away
